The CMTSE Study Guide contains 14 custom eLearning modules that are not part of our traditional catalog.
Each chapter is an external learning class that is loaded into the AMT admin center.
- Each chapter contains an outline, introduction, review of sample exam questions, and additional reference bibliographies.
The study guide completion is required prior to taking the exam.
Students will have access to the study guide content for 365 days from purchase.
